scenes.label: 简化桌面静物（固定正面视点）
scenes.content_prompt: One continuous still-life illustration with no people, faces or animals. A single rectangular table stands centred in a straight-on frontal view before a plain back wall, under soft gentle daytime light from the left. Its existing tablecloth is warm light grey. On the table are exactly one closed notebook with a visible closed notebook cover, one empty plain matte mug with its handle visible, and one small natural-brown plant pot containing a compact plant with green leaves. Keep the closed notebook cover and mug as two separate existing objects. Preserve the green leaves, natural-brown plant pot, the matte ceramic mug surface, the paper notebook cover surface, table shape, object count and fixed positions: notebook on the left, mug on the right, plant pot behind them, all fully inside the frame. The back wall, tablecloth, closed notebook cover and mug are all clearly visible as separate bounded surfaces, with the same viewpoint, object scale and lighting direction throughout. There are no additional books, flowers, scattered leaves, fruit, ribbons, coloured decorations, labels or writing. Do not enlarge, move or add objects to change colour coverage. Draw with fine ink contours and gently layered matte illustration shading, with readable local shadows and highlights; no photorealism, panels, text, palette charts or collage.
protected_facts: exactly one empty plain matte mug with a visible handle
notebook left, mug right, plant pot behind
fixed straight-on frontal viewpoint and object scale
table, mug and notebook shapes and materials
scenes.auxiliary_note: No auxiliary colour authorization in this round; the tablecloth stays warm light grey.
